user.title: Browser helper ready?
user.description:
**Unofficial** – not affiliated with Lidl, SilverCrest or Tecpal.

Signing in needs the small **browser helper**, once. It catches the sign-in code after the login and hands it over automatically – nothing to copy.

➡️ **[Download & install the browser helper](https://github.com/MrVain74/ha-monsieur-cuisine/tree/main/browser-helper)** (short guide there, about a minute – first time only).

**Is the helper installed and enabled?** Then press **Submit** below – the Lidl sign-in page opens next.

login.title: Sign in with Lidl
login.description:
Click **Open website** below and sign in with Lidl (e-mail, password and captcha are up to you).

The browser helper then hands the sign-in code over automatically – this dialog closes **on its own**.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in with Lidl again
reauth_confirm.description:
The stored session is no longer valid (e.g. after a password change or a long break). Signing in with Lidl once more restores the connection – your device and all settings stay in place.

**Browser helper active?** Then press **Submit** below – the Lidl sign-in page opens next.

abort.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Please start the login again (the code is only valid briefly).
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monsieur Cuisine cloud. Please try again later.
abort.no_url: Home Assistant does not know its own address. Please set a URL under Settings → System → Network.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful – the connection is back.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: This sign-in belongs to a different account. Please sign in with the same account that was set up originally.

send_recipe.name: Send recipe to Monsieur Cuisine
send_recipe.description: Converts a recipe (web page with schema.org data or JSON) into a Monsieur Cuisine recipe with machine steps and creates it in your account.

url.name: Recipe URL
url.description: Web page with a recipe (schema.org/Recipe, e.g. Chefkoch, Mealie).

recipe.name: Recipe (JSON)
recipe.description: schema.org/Recipe object as an alternative to the URL.

recipe_id.name: Existing recipe
recipe_id.description: ID of one of your recipes to overwrite.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Do not create anything, just return the detected steps.
